about_the_game:
This bundle contains:

  • Tier VIII Premium French ELC EVEN 90 light tank
  • Garage slot
  • Crew including a Commander with any zero perk of choice
  • 30 days of WoT Premium Account

Bundle description:

Get ready to be the ultimate scout with the Invisible Spotter Pack! The vehicle included in this bundle is the famous Tier VIII Premium French ELC EVEN 90 light tank—the true king of stealth and disguise on the battlefield.


Concealment and Speed: It is said that the only way to spot the ELC EVEN 90 is to accidentally slam into it in your tank. Although it is just a joke, finding this French light tank on the battlefield is far from an easy task. It has the best camouflage values among its tier, and you can further increase them with crew skills and equipment, making the tank as close to a stealthy ninja as a 6.5-ton steel machine can be. Besides that, it is ludicrously small and has a top speed of 70 km/h, so trying to hit this tank while it’s on the move is just as hard as spotting it in the first place.

Firepower: Let’s just say that the ELC EVEN 90 was not designed to be a damage dealer. In fact, it has the lowest DPM among all Tier VIII light tanks, so you should stick to scouting and avoid getting into direct combat. Still, having an autoloader with three shells in its magazine and being able to burst out 660 HP of damage in five seconds might be very useful at the end of a battle or when your allies need extra supporting fire.

Protection: Being extremely lightweight and stealthy has its limitations. This tank has virtually no armor, so your best protection is your ability to stay undetected. The tiny profile of the tank allows you to use most bushes and hard cover on maps, and its very decent mobility lets you relocate quickly if the situation starts getting out of hand. Stay out of the hassle, remain invisible to your opponents, and provide valuable recon information to your teammates to earn the victory!

This package also includes 30 days of WoT Premium Account, which will help you progress faster in the game by providing a variety of extra bonuses, such as more credits and XP earned in battles, an applicable modifier to XP, Premium missions, one more slot for excluded maps, and more.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
You will be able to use this DLC only if you play from the game account created on Steam.
